acceptance_predicates.description: The configured OpenRouter provider/model/credential-reference identity used by provider-plan is the same identity accepted by benchmark-live selected and all-agent paths.
A configured OpenRouter selection executes benchmark-live selected scope successfully in human and versioned JSON output without exposing credentials.
The same configuration executes bounded all-agent benchmark-live scope successfully in human and versioned JSON output with one typed result per agent.
Missing configuration, stale selection, invalid identity, missing key, and provider failure remain typed nonzero errors with no mock or replay fallback.
Only provider/model identifiers, bounded digests, statuses, timings, and token counters enter evidence; keys, prompts, responses, and private paths do not.

definition_of_done: Repair is implemented on a clean product-bound branch with positive and negative tests.
Independent exact-head review, applicable full gates, hosted exact-head CI, signed protected merge, and exact-main post-merge workflows pass.
AR-1715 is requalified with secure-key selected/all live evidence and a durable redacted receipt.

inputs.description: AR-1715 secure-key selected/all transport and CLI identity failure evidence.
AR-1711 bounded selected/all benchmark-live execution contract.
provider-plan --use-config and persisted OpenRouter setup configuration.

outputs.description: Canonical OpenRouter configuration and selection identity across planning and execution.
Selected/all human and versioned JSON benchmark-live qualification evidence.
Typed negative and no-fallback regression coverage.

gates.description: Provider-plan, saved selection, and benchmark-live identity agree for configured OpenRouter.
Selected/all human and JSON paths plus typed negative cases pass without fallback.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed merge, and exact-main post-merge workflows pass.
